text_simplified: The text tells the story of a child who was crying intensely and kicking the wall. His father gently reproached him and asked about the reason for his anger. The child explained that he was angry with his father because he had not told him that the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was the most beloved person to him, and the child affirmed his love for the Prophet ﷺ. The text aims to teach parents the importance of planting the love of the Prophet ﷺ in the hearts of children from a young age.
